title: Trae and Windsurf export no dialogue: Trae store is encrypted, Windsurf history is server-side
blocker: (2026-08-31): Trae keeps it in `Library/Application Support/Trae/ModularData/ai-agent/database.db`, which has no SQLite header and is opaque at rest, so an exporter is blocked on decryption; Windsurf has no local dialogue store at all (Cascade history is server-side). The bogus Trae records from VS Code picker state were fixed the same day. **Blocked on:** a way to decrypt Trae's store; Windsurf needs a server-side export, if any exists.
notes: 2026-11-24 audit: unchanged and still blocked. scribe lists trae and windsurf in constants/CONVERSATION_SOURCES.ts but no decryption or server-export code exists (only commit f65ea63 mentions them). Trae app data dir is absent on this machine now (ls of ~/Library/Application Support shows no Trae or Windsurf), so the encrypted-store claim cannot be re-verified here. Smallest next step: install Trae and check whether database.db is still headerless; otherwise leave low priority.
